positions.title: Contract Software Engineer
positions.locationName: San Diego, California, United States · Remote
positions.description:
Design and implement a comprehensive web application to manage restaurant operations.
Implement features to streamline menu management, staffing, work scheduling, and ordering.
Collaborate with product managers and UX/UI designers to define requirements and deliver scalable solutions.
Implement robust back-end solutions using PHP and Laravel.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Las Vegas, Nevada, United States · On-site
positions.description:
Developed video slot machine games for the global market. Games were developed in C++ using a proprietary graphics engine.
Implemented specialized game functions to ensure engaging gameplay.
Collaborated with artists and sound designers to integrate video and audio effects into games.
Responsible for understanding and adhering to state regulatory requirements regarding gambling gaming products.
Conducted thorough testing and debugging of games to ensure smooth and error-free gameplay.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: San Diego, California, United States · On-site
positions.description:
Responsible for maintaining, debugging, and enhancing the data pipeline which transferred data from SmartDrive’s onboard vehicle cameras and stored driving metrics in MS SQL databases in the datacenter.
Designed and implemented a Windows Service to manage uploading of data from customer sites to the SmartDrive datacenter. The service was implemented in C#, and utilized Microsoft BITS technology for data transfer.
Refactored SQL queries responsible for the insertion of data into SmartDrive OLTP databases to minimize deadlocks.
Implemented a RESTful Web Service using Web API to report system health and perform health checks.
Maintained and enhanced the SmartDrive Silverlight video player.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: San Diego, California, United States · On-site
positions.description:
Designed and implemented an xml script driven test harness using C# and C++. The test harness is used to automate stress testing of the company’s digital recording system, which is marketed to emergency services such as 911 call centers.
Developed a RTSP server to provide Internet based playback of audio and video as specified by the Next Generation 911 initiative.
Developed a passive recording module to capture encrypted RTP audio packets. The software decrypts the AES / DES payload, and transcodes from IMBE to PCM audio.
Developed a module to encode security camera motion JPEG streams into H264 video. An open source x264 encoder compiled on Windows using MinGW / MSYS was used, and the video was stored in a MP4 container.
Worked on maintaining a legacy recording system developed using C++ / MFC. Also worked on a Silverlight application to search the database for recordings created by the legacy system.

company.name: Equature - Built to Serve Public Safety

positions.title: Contract Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Lake Oswego, Oregon, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
Developed a Windows based video player that performs real-time 2D to 3D conversion. The player was written in C++, utilizing Microsoft's DirectShow and Direct3D technologies. Key components of the 2D to 3D conversion engine were implemented in HLSL. The video player performed real-time 2D to 3D conversion on DVDs, Blu-rays, and Windows media files.
Developed software to perform 2D to 3D video conversion in a script driven, background processing mode. The software was written in C++, utilizing Microsoft's Media Foundation SDK. OpenCL was used to program the pixel shaders for improved performance.
Developed software to display 3D video over the Internet. The player was written in C#, using Microsoft's Silverlight technology.
